:::{#thm-bernoulli-score}
#### Score function of a Bernoulli variable

Let $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$, with event probability $\prob$ and observed value $x \in \cb{0, 1}$.
The [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) $\score$ of the single observation $x$
is the derivative of its log-likelihood $\loglik$ with respect to $\prob$.
It equals the deviation of $x$ from the mean $\E{X}$,
divided by the variance $\Var{X}$:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-derive-bernoulli-score, worked in @sol-derive-bernoulli-score.
It builds on @thm-bernoulli-loglik-one-group, with $n = 1$.

:::
